1!------------------------------------------------------------------------------!2!> Full-stack tests of the assembled axisymmetric vacuum matrices G and H3!! (vac_ops.calc_GH, style 2) through Green's identities, and of the boundary4!! potential solve (vac_ops.solve_Phi_BEM).5!!6!! For potentials phi e^{i n zeta}, with dphi := norm . grad phi the normal7!! derivative along the stored normal norm = -J grad psi (out of the vacuum,8!! the convention of both vacuum styles), the boundary element9!! discretization satisfies the jump relations10!!    H phi - G dphi = -4 pi phi   for phi harmonic inside the boundary,11!!    H phi - G dphi = 0           for phi harmonic outside and decaying,12!! which the ldebug branch of calc_GH also plots for manual inspection. Here13!! both are automated with assertions on a synthetic circular boundary14!!    R(t) = R_0 + a cos t,   Z(t) = a sin t,  t in [0,2 pi],15!! built the same way store_vac_HEL builds its boundary (the last point16!! duplicates the first).17!!18!! Test potentials:19!!  - phi = R^n        (regular inside the boundary),20!!  - phi = R^n Z      (regular inside the boundary),21!!  - phi = Q_{n-1/2}(gamma(x,x_src))/sqrt(R R_src) with x_src inside the22!!    plasma: the n-mode Green's function, regular and decaying outside --23!!    the class the vacuum response solve works on.24!!25!! The residuals are normalized by max |H phi| (or max |4 pi phi|).26!------------------------------------------------------------------------------!27module test_vac_greens28    use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: error_unit29    use testdrive, only: new_unittest, unittest_type, error_type, check30    use num_vars, only: dp, pi, rank31    use str_utilities, only: r2str, i2str32    use dtorh, only: dtorh133    use vac_vars, only: vac_type34    use vac_ops, only: calc_GH, solve_Phi_BEM35 36    implicit none37    private38    public collect_vac_greens39 40    ! circular boundary parameters41    real(dp), parameter :: R_0 = 3.0_dp                                         ! major radius42    real(dp), parameter :: a_min = 1.0_dp                                       ! minor radius43    integer, parameter :: prim_X_test = 2                                       ! toroidal mode number44 45contains46    !> Collect the tests.47    subroutine collect_vac_greens(testsuite)48        type(unittest_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: testsuite(:)49 50        testsuite = [ &51            &new_unittest("greens_identity", test_greens_identity), &52            &new_unittest("greens_identity_convergence", &53            &   test_greens_convergence), &54            &new_unittest("solve_Phi_BEM_roundtrip", test_solve_roundtrip), &55            &new_unittest("vac_response_cylinder", test_response_cylinder), &56            &new_unittest("greens_identity_indirect", test_greens_indirect) &57            &]58    end subroutine collect_vac_greens59 60    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------61    ! helpers62    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------63 64    !> Set up the synthetic circular vacuum boundary (the geometry arrays are65    !! global, so every process fills them completely; only G, H and res are66    !! distributed).67    subroutine setup_circle_vac(vac,n_bnd,ierr)68        type(vac_type), intent(inout) :: vac                                    ! vacuum variables69        integer, intent(in) :: n_bnd                                            ! number of boundary points (last = first)70        integer, intent(out) :: ierr                                            ! error status71 72        integer :: id                                                           ! counter73        real(dp) :: t, R                                                        ! angle, major radius74 75        ierr = vac%init(2,n_bnd,prim_X_test,[n_bnd,1],1._dp)76        if (ierr.ne.0) return77 78        do id = 1,n_bnd79            t = 2._dp*pi*(id-1)/(n_bnd-1)80            R = R_0 + a_min*cos(t)81            vac%ang(id,1) = t82            vac%x_vec(id,:) = [R, a_min*sin(t)]83            vac%norm(id,:) = [-R*a_min*cos(t), -R*a_min*sin(t)]84            vac%dnorm(id,:) = [a_min*sin(t)*(a_min*cos(t)+R), &85                &a_min*(a_min*sin(t)**2-R*cos(t))]86        end do87    end subroutine setup_circle_vac88 89    !> Test potential and its dphi = norm.grad phi on the boundary.90    !!91    !! Kinds: 1: R^n, 2: R^n Z, 3: n-mode Green's function with an interior92    !! source (exterior harmonic).93    subroutine eval_potential(vac,kind,phi,dphi,ierr)94        type(vac_type), intent(in) :: vac                                       ! vacuum variables95        integer, intent(in) :: kind                                             ! which potential96        real(dp), intent(out) :: phi(:), dphi(:)                                ! potential and norm.grad97        integer, intent(out) :: ierr                                            ! error status98 99        integer :: id                                                           ! counter100        integer :: n                                                            ! mode number101        real(dp) :: R, Z                                                        ! coordinates102        real(dp) :: x_pert(2)                                                   ! perturbed point103        real(dp) :: fp, fm                                                      ! function values104        real(dp), parameter :: eps = 1.e-7_dp                                   ! step for central difference105        real(dp), parameter :: x_src(2) = [R_0-0.3_dp*a_min,0.1_dp*a_min]       ! interior source for kind 3106 107        ierr = 0108        n = vac%prim_X109        do id = 1,vac%n_bnd110            R = vac%x_vec(id,1)111            Z = vac%x_vec(id,2)112            select case (kind)113                case (1)                                                        ! R^n114                    phi(id) = R**n115                    dphi(id) = vac%norm(id,1)*n*R**(n-1)116                case (2)                                                        ! R^n Z117                    phi(id) = R**n*Z118                    dphi(id) = vac%norm(id,1)*n*R**(n-1)*Z + &119                        &vac%norm(id,2)*R**n120                case (3)                                                        ! Green's function source121                    ierr = green_pot(vac%x_vec(id,:),x_src,n,phi(id))122                    if (ierr.ne.0) return123                    ! dphi by central difference along norm124                    x_pert = vac%x_vec(id,:) + eps*vac%norm(id,:)125                    ierr = green_pot(x_pert,x_src,n,fp)126                    if (ierr.ne.0) return127                    x_pert = vac%x_vec(id,:) - eps*vac%norm(id,:)128                    ierr = green_pot(x_pert,x_src,n,fm)129                    if (ierr.ne.0) return130                    dphi(id) = (fp-fm)/(2._dp*eps)131            end select132        end do133    end subroutine eval_potential134 135    !> The n-mode Green's function potential136    !! Q_{n-1/2}(gamma(x,x_src))/sqrt(R R_src).137    integer function green_pot(x,x_src,n,res) result(ierr)138        real(dp), intent(in) :: x(2), x_src(2)                                  ! evaluation and source points139        integer, intent(in) :: n                                                ! mode number140        real(dp), intent(out) :: res                                            ! potential141 142        real(dp) :: gam                                                         ! argument143        real(dp) :: pl_loc(0:n), ql_loc(0:n)                                    ! toroidal harmonics144        integer :: newn                                                         ! maximum reached degree145 146        gam = 1._dp + sum((x-x_src)**2)/(2._dp*x(1)*x_src(1))147        ierr = dtorh1(gam,0,n,pl_loc,ql_loc,newn)148        if (ierr.eq.0 .and. newn.lt.n) ierr = 1149        res = ql_loc(n)/sqrt(x(1)*x_src(1))150    end function green_pot151 152    !> Assemble G and H for a circular boundary and return the Green's153    !! identity residuals max|H phi - G dphi - c phi| / max|4 pi phi| for the154    !! three test potentials, with c = -4 pi (interior) or 0 (exterior).155    !!156    !! The products with the distributed matrices are evaluated globally on157    !! all processes (see fullstack_utils), so the assertions are identical158    !! everywhere; processes outside the BLACS context report zero residuals.159    subroutine greens_residuals(n_bnd,res,ierr)160        use num_vars, only: rank161        use vac_vars, only: in_context162        use vac_utilities, only: dis_matvec163 164        integer, intent(in) :: n_bnd                                            ! number of boundary points165        real(dp), intent(out) :: res(3)                                         ! residuals for the potentials166        integer, intent(out) :: ierr                                            ! error status167 168        type(vac_type) :: vac                                                   ! vacuum variables169        integer :: kind                                                         ! potential kind170        real(dp), allocatable :: phi(:), dphi(:)                                ! potential and normal derivative171        real(dp), allocatable :: lhs(:), rhs(:)                                 ! H phi and G dphi172 173        res = 0._dp174        call setup_circle_vac(vac,n_bnd,ierr)175        if (ierr.ne.0) return176 177        ierr = calc_GH(vac)178        if (ierr.ne.0) return179 180        if (in_context(vac%ctxt_HG)) then181            allocate(phi(n_bnd),dphi(n_bnd),lhs(n_bnd),rhs(n_bnd))182            do kind = 1,3183                call eval_potential(vac,kind,phi,dphi,ierr)184                if (ierr.ne.0) return185                ierr = dis_matvec(vac,vac%H,vac%desc_H,phi,lhs)186                if (ierr.ne.0) return187                ierr = dis_matvec(vac,vac%G,vac%desc_G,dphi,rhs)188                if (ierr.ne.0) return189                select case (kind)190                    case (1,2)                                                  ! interior: H phi - G dphi = -4 pi phi191                        res(kind) = maxval(abs(lhs-rhs+4._dp*pi*phi))/&192                            &maxval(abs(4._dp*pi*phi))193                    case (3)                                                    ! exterior: H phi - G dphi = 0194                        res(kind) = maxval(abs(lhs-rhs))/&195                            &maxval(abs(4._dp*pi*phi))196                end select197                if (rank.eq.0) write(error_unit,'(A,I6,A,I2,A,ES10.3)') &198                    &'   [greens residual] n_bnd = ',n_bnd,', potential ',&199                    &kind,': ',res(kind)200            end do201        end if202 203        call vac%dealloc()204    end subroutine greens_residuals205 206    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------207    ! tests208    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------209 210    !> Green's identities for the three test potentials.211    !!212    !! The discretization converges at first order (the trapezoidal rule213    !! meets the logarithmic kernel singularity right outside the tiny214    !! analytically-integrated region), so the residuals at n_bnd = 101 are215    !! at the percent level; convergence is checked separately.216    subroutine test_greens_identity(error)217        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error218 219        integer, parameter :: n_bnd = 101                                       ! boundary points220        real(dp), parameter :: tol = 5.e-2_dp                                   ! relative tolerance221 222        integer :: ierr, kind                                                   ! error status, counter223        real(dp) :: res(3)                                                      ! residuals224 225        call greens_residuals(n_bnd,res,ierr)226        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'assembly failed')227        if (allocated(error)) return228 229        do kind = 1,3230            call check(error, res(kind).lt.tol, &231                &'Green identity residual for potential '//&232                &trim(i2str(kind))//' too large: '//trim(r2str(res(kind))))233            if (allocated(error)) return234        end do235    end subroutine test_greens_identity236 237    !> The identity residual has to decrease with resolution (first order:238    !! it halves when the number of points doubles).239    subroutine test_greens_convergence(error)240        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error241 242        integer :: ierr, kind                                                   ! error status, counter243        real(dp) :: res_lo(3), res_hi(3)                                        ! residuals at two resolutions244 245        call greens_residuals(51,res_lo,ierr)246        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'assembly failed')247        if (allocated(error)) return248        call greens_residuals(101,res_hi,ierr)249        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'assembly failed')250        if (allocated(error)) return251 252        do kind = 1,3253            call check(error, res_hi(kind).lt.0.7_dp*res_lo(kind), &254                &'no convergence for potential '//trim(i2str(kind))//': '//&255                &trim(r2str(res_lo(kind)))//' -> '//trim(r2str(res_hi(kind))))256            if (allocated(error)) return257        end do258    end subroutine test_greens_convergence259 260    !> Solving H Phi = G R with R = dphi of a known vacuum-side harmonic261    !! potential has to return its boundary trace Phi = phi.262    !!263    !! Note that this also covers the duplicated seam point of the closed264    !! boundary: the integral parts of the two rows are identical, and only265    !! the corner term -2 beta on the diagonal lifts the degeneracy and266    !! enforces the equality of the two coinciding solution values.267    subroutine test_solve_roundtrip(error)268        use vac_vars, only: in_context, set_loc_lims269        use vac_utilities, only: vec_dis2loc270        use vac_utilities, only: n_col1_loc, vec_glob2dis271 272        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error273 274        integer, parameter :: n_bnd = 101                                       ! boundary points275        real(dp), parameter :: tol = 5.e-2_dp                                   ! relative tolerance276 277        type(vac_type) :: vac                                                   ! vacuum variables278        integer :: ierr                                                         ! error status279        integer :: n_col1                                                       ! local number of columns of R and Phi280        integer :: desc_RPhi(9)                                                 ! descriptor for R and Phi281        integer, allocatable :: lims_c_R(:,:)                                   ! local column limits of R and Phi282        real(dp), allocatable :: phi(:), dphi(:)                                ! potential and normal derivative283        real(dp), allocatable :: R_mat(:,:), Phi_mat(:,:)                       ! distributed right-hand side and solution284        real(dp), allocatable :: phi_num(:)                                     ! gathered numerical solution285        real(dp) :: err_sol                                                     ! solution error286 287        call setup_circle_vac(vac,n_bnd,ierr)288        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'setup failed')289        if (allocated(error)) return290 291        ierr = calc_GH(vac)292        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'assembly failed')293        if (allocated(error)) return294 295        allocate(phi(n_bnd),dphi(n_bnd))296        call eval_potential(vac,3,phi,dphi,ierr)                                ! exterior (Green's function) potential297        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'potential evaluation failed')298        if (allocated(error)) return299 300        err_sol = 0._dp301        if (in_context(vac%ctxt_HG)) then302            ! distributed n_bnd x 1 right-hand side, as in calc_vac_res303            n_col1 = n_col1_loc(vac)304            call set_loc_lims(n_col1,vac%bs,vac%ind_p(2),vac%n_p(2),lims_c_R)305            allocate(R_mat(max(1,vac%n_loc(1)),n_col1))306            allocate(Phi_mat(max(1,vac%n_loc(1)),n_col1))307            if (n_col1.gt.0) call vec_glob2dis(vac,dphi,R_mat(:,1))308            Phi_mat = 0._dp309            call descinit(desc_RPhi,n_bnd,1,vac%bs,vac%bs,0,0,vac%ctxt_HG,&310                &max(1,vac%n_loc(1)),ierr)311            call check(error, ierr, 0, 'descinit failed')312            if (allocated(error)) return313 314            ierr = solve_Phi_BEM(vac,R_mat,Phi_mat,[n_bnd,1],&315                &[vac%n_loc(1),n_col1],lims_c_R,desc_RPhi)316            call check(error, ierr, 0, 'solve_Phi_BEM failed')317            if (allocated(error)) return318 319            ! gather the solution on all processes and compare globally320            allocate(phi_num(n_bnd))321            ierr = vec_dis2loc(vac%ctxt_HG,&322                &reshape(Phi_mat(1:vac%n_loc(1),:),[vac%n_loc(1)*n_col1]),&323                &vac%lims_r,phi_num)324            call check(error, ierr, 0, 'gather failed')325            if (allocated(error)) return326 327            err_sol = maxval(abs(phi_num-phi))/maxval(abs(phi))328        end if329        call check(error, err_sol.lt.tol, &330            &'solve round-trip error too large: '//trim(r2str(err_sol)))331        if (allocated(error)) return332 333        call vac%dealloc()334    end subroutine test_solve_roundtrip335 336    !> The vacuum response matrix on the circular boundary against the337    !! analytical large-aspect-ratio (cylinder) limit.338    !!339    !! In the cylinder limit, the decaying exterior solution for poloidal340    !! Fourier boundary data e^{i m theta} is proportional to r^-|m|, so the341    !! full chain of calc_vac_res (Neumann data -(n q - m) e^{-i m theta}342    !! along the stored normal out of the vacuum, exterior solve, projection343    !! with the integration rule, the factor 2 pi of the toroidal integral344    !! that turns the Neumann-to-Dirichlet map into the surface-energy345    !! Hessian) reduces to346    !!    res_{m m'} = 4 pi^2 (n q - m)^2 / (R_0 |m| mu_0) delta_{m m'},347    !! twice the vacuum energy of the edge displacement, with toroidal348    !! corrections of order a/R_0. This pins sign, scaling and mode structure349    !! of the response that enters the SLEPc boundary condition (set_BC_2,350    !! set_BC_4) and POST's energy balance.351    subroutine test_response_cylinder(error)352        use X_vars, only: n_mod_X, modes_type353        use num_vars, only: use_pol_flux_F, eq_style, rank354        use eq_vars, only: vac_perm355        use vac_ops, only: calc_vac_res356        use fullstack_utils, only: gather_res357 358        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error359 360        integer, parameter :: n_bnd = 201                                       ! boundary points361        integer, parameter :: n_mod = 5                                         ! number of poloidal modes, m = 1..n_mod362        real(dp), parameter :: R_big = 20.0_dp                                  ! major radius (large aspect ratio)363        real(dp), parameter :: jq = 1.35_dp                                     ! safety factor at edge (nonresonant: n jq - m /= 0)364        real(dp), parameter :: tol_diag = 0.25_dp                               ! relative tolerance on the diagonal (aspect-ratio corrections)365        real(dp), parameter :: tol_offdiag = 0.10_dp                            ! off-diagonal tolerance, relative to largest diagonal366 367        type(vac_type) :: vac                                                   ! vacuum variables368        type(modes_type) :: mds                                                 ! minimal modes variables369        integer :: ierr, id, jd                                                 ! error status, counters370        integer :: n_mod_X_old                                                  ! original n_mod_X371        real(dp) :: t, R                                                        ! angle, major radius372        real(dp) :: res_ana                                                     ! analytical response373        real(dp) :: rel_diff                                                    ! relative difference374        complex(dp), allocatable :: res(:,:)                                    ! response, gathered on all processes375 376        ! the response needs several modes; restore module state afterwards377        n_mod_X_old = n_mod_X378        n_mod_X = n_mod379        use_pol_flux_F = .true.380        eq_style = 2                                                            ! HELENA (axisymmetric)381 382        ! minimal modes tables: only the last row of m is used383        allocate(mds%m(1,n_mod),mds%n(1,n_mod))384        mds%m(1,:) = [(id, id=1,n_mod)]385        mds%n(1,:) = prim_X_test386 387        ! circular boundary at large aspect ratio388        ierr = vac%init(2,n_bnd,prim_X_test,[n_bnd,1],jq)389        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'init failed')390        if (allocated(error)) return391        do id = 1,n_bnd392            t = 2._dp*pi*(id-1)/(n_bnd-1)393            R = R_big + a_min*cos(t)394            vac%ang(id,1) = t395            vac%x_vec(id,:) = [R, a_min*sin(t)]396            vac%norm(id,:) = [-R*a_min*cos(t), -R*a_min*sin(t)]397            vac%dnorm(id,:) = [a_min*sin(t)*(a_min*cos(t)+R), &398                &a_min*(a_min*sin(t)**2-R*cos(t))]399        end do400 401        ierr = calc_vac_res(mds,vac)402        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'calc_vac_res failed')403        if (allocated(error)) return404 405        ! the response only lives on the last process: gather it everywhere406        ! so that all processes run identical assertions407        allocate(res(n_mod,n_mod))408        ierr = gather_res(vac,res)409        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'gathering the response failed')410        if (allocated(error)) return411 412        do id = 1,n_mod413            do jd = 1,n_mod414                if (id.eq.jd) then415                    ! 2 dW_vac = 4 pi^2 (nq-m)^2 |X_e|^2 / (mu_0 R_0 |m|) in the416                    ! cylinder: the Neumann-to-Dirichlet map 2 pi (nq-m)^2 /417                    ! (mu_0 R_0 |m|) times the factor 2 pi of calc_vac_res418                    res_ana = 4._dp*pi**2*(prim_X_test*jq-mds%m(1,id))**2/&419                        &(R_big*abs(mds%m(1,id))*vac_perm)420                    rel_diff = abs(real(res(id,id))-res_ana)/&421                        &abs(res_ana)422                    if (rank.eq.0) &423                        &write(error_unit,'(A,I2,A,ES12.5,A,ES12.5,A,F6.3)') &424                        &'   [vac response] m = ',mds%m(1,id),': res = ',&425                        &real(res(id,id)),', cylinder = ',res_ana,&426                        &', rel diff = ',rel_diff427                    call check(error, rel_diff.lt.tol_diag, &428                        &'diagonal response for m = '//trim(i2str(id))//&429                        &' deviates from cylinder limit by '//&430                        &trim(r2str(rel_diff)))431                else432                    call check(error, abs(res(id,jd)).lt.tol_offdiag*&433                        &2._dp*pi*(prim_X_test*jq-1._dp)**2/&434                        &(R_big*vac_perm), &435                        &'off-diagonal response ('//trim(i2str(id))//','//&436                        &trim(i2str(jd))//') too large: '//&437                        &trim(r2str(abs(res(id,jd)))))438                end if439                if (allocated(error)) exit440            end do441            if (allocated(error)) exit442        end do443 444        ! clean up and restore module state445        call vac%dealloc()446        call mds%dealloc()447        n_mod_X = n_mod_X_old448        if (allocated(error)) return449    end subroutine test_response_cylinder450    451    !> The Green identities with the indirect diagonals of the axisymmetric452    !! style (vac_diag_style 1: H_ii and G_ii from the least-squares solution453    !! of the identities for R^n, R^n Z and the ring-source potential), which454    !! must hold as well as with the direct ones.455    subroutine test_greens_indirect(error)456        use num_vars, only: vac_diag_style457        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error458        integer, parameter :: n_bnd = 101                                       ! boundary points459        real(dp), parameter :: tol = 5.e-2_dp                                   ! relative tolerance460        integer :: ierr, kind                                                   ! error status, counter461        integer :: style_old                                                    ! saved module state462        real(dp) :: res_dir(3), res_ind(3)                                      ! residuals, direct and indirect diagonals463        464        style_old = vac_diag_style465        vac_diag_style = 2466        call greens_residuals(n_bnd,res_dir,ierr)467        if (ierr.eq.0) then468            vac_diag_style = 1469            call greens_residuals(n_bnd,res_ind,ierr)470        end if471        vac_diag_style = style_old472        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'assembly failed')473        if (allocated(error)) return474        do kind = 1,3475            if (rank.eq.0) write(error_unit,'(A,I2,A,2ES10.3)') &476                &'   [greens indirect] potential ',kind,&477                &': residual direct, indirect: ',res_dir(kind),res_ind(kind)478            call check(error, res_ind(kind).lt.tol, &479                &'Green identity residual with the indirect diagonals for &480                &potential '//trim(i2str(kind))//' too large: '//&481                &trim(r2str(res_ind(kind))))482            if (allocated(error)) return483        end do484    end subroutine test_greens_indirect485 486end module test_vac_greens

1!------------------------------------------------------------------------------!2!> Full-stack tests of the 3-D (field-line aligned, style 1) vacuum: the3!! singular interval kernel, the assembled G and H matrices through Green's4!! identities, and the vacuum response against the (independently verified)5!! axisymmetric style-2 calculation of the same boundary.6!!7!! The geometry is an analytical circular torus8!!    x = (R cos zeta, R sin zeta, a sin theta),   R = R_0 + a cos theta,9!! covered by field lines zeta = alpha + q theta on a product grid10!! (theta, alpha) in [0,2 pi] x [0,2 pi), theta with both ends included11!! (trapezoidal half-weights on the duplicated edge) and alpha without its12!! end point, exactly as PB3D lays out its field lines (rich_ops:13!! calc_eqd_grid with excl_last; the map is a shear, so this tiles the torus14!! once). In PB3D's flux coordinates15!! (alpha, psi, theta) the exact geometric quantities are16!!    e_theta = dx/dtheta|_alpha,   e_alpha = dx/dalpha,17!!    norm    = J nabla psi = e_theta x e_alpha,18!!    h_fac   = (g_aa, g_at, g_tt, ...) = (|e_alpha|^2, e_alpha.e_theta,19!!              |e_theta|^2, ...),20!! all available in closed form.21!!22!! For the assembled matrices, with dphi := norm . grad phi, the jump23!! relations analogous to the style-2 ones are measured empirically; note24!! that calc_GH constructs the H diagonal through the constant-potential25!! row-sum identity (H 1 = -4 pi 1 by construction).26!------------------------------------------------------------------------------!27module test_vac_3d28    use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: error_unit29    use testdrive, only: new_unittest, unittest_type, error_type, check30    use num_vars, only: dp, pi31    use str_utilities, only: r2str, i2str32    use vac_vars, only: vac_type33    use vac_utilities, only: calc_GH_int_134    use vac_ops, only: calc_GH35 36    implicit none37    private38    public collect_vac_3d39 40    ! circular torus parameters41    real(dp), parameter :: R_0 = 3.0_dp                                         ! major radius42    real(dp), parameter :: a_min = 1.0_dp                                       ! minor radius43    real(dp), parameter :: q_saf = 1.35_dp                                      ! safety factor at the boundary44    ! 8-point Gauss-Legendre rule on [-1,1], for brute-force references45    real(dp), parameter :: gl_x(8) = [&46        &-0.9602898564975363_dp, -0.7966664774136267_dp, &47        &-0.5255324099163290_dp, -0.1834346424956498_dp, &48        & 0.1834346424956498_dp,  0.5255324099163290_dp, &49        & 0.7966664774136267_dp,  0.9602898564975363_dp]50    real(dp), parameter :: gl_w(8) = [&51        &0.1012285362903763_dp, 0.2223810344533745_dp, &52        &0.3137066458778873_dp, 0.3626837833783620_dp, &53        &0.3626837833783620_dp, 0.3137066458778873_dp, &54        &0.2223810344533745_dp, 0.1012285362903763_dp]55 56contains57    !> Collect the tests.58    subroutine collect_vac_3d(testsuite)59        type(unittest_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: testsuite(:)60 61        testsuite = [ &62            &new_unittest("GH_int_1_singular", test_int_1_singular), &63            &new_unittest("GH_int_1_near", test_int_1_near), &64            &new_unittest("greens_identity_3d", test_greens_identity_3d), &65            &new_unittest("response_1_vs_2", test_response_1_vs_2), &66            &new_unittest("point_source_3d", test_point_source_3d), &67            &new_unittest("exact_exterior_2d", test_exact_exterior_2d), &68            &new_unittest("solid_angle_node", test_solid_angle_node), &69            &new_unittest("H_sing_node", test_H_sing_node), &70            &new_unittest("diag_direct_3d", test_diag_direct_3d), &71            &new_unittest("point_source_direct_3d", test_point_source_direct), &72            &new_unittest("exact_exterior_2d_options", test_exact_2d_options) &73            &]74    end subroutine collect_vac_3d75 76    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------77    ! helpers78    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------79 80    !> Position and flux-coordinate tangents on the field line, for the81    !! circular torus or, with a ripple amplitude delta, for the rippled torus82    !! with minor radius a(zeta) = a_min (1 + delta cos(N_rip zeta)).83    pure subroutine torus(theta,alpha,x,e_theta,e_alpha,delta)84        real(dp), intent(in) :: theta, alpha                                    ! angles85        real(dp), intent(out) :: x(3)                                           ! position86        real(dp), intent(out), optional :: e_theta(3), e_alpha(3)               ! tangents87        real(dp), intent(in), optional :: delta                                 ! ripple amplitude88 89        integer, parameter :: N_rip = 5                                         ! ripple periods90        real(dp) :: R, zeta                                                     ! major radius, toroidal angle91        real(dp) :: a, da                                                       ! minor radius and its zeta derivative92        real(dp) :: dR_t, dz_t, dR_a, dz_a                                      ! derivatives of R and z along theta and alpha93 94        zeta = alpha + q_saf*theta95        a = a_min96        da = 0._dp97        if (present(delta)) then98            a = a_min*(1._dp + delta*cos(N_rip*zeta))99            da = -a_min*delta*N_rip*sin(N_rip*zeta)100        end if101        R = R_0 + a*cos(theta)102        x = [R*cos(zeta), R*sin(zeta), a*sin(theta)]103        if (present(e_theta)) then104            dR_t = da*q_saf*cos(theta) - a*sin(theta)105            dz_t = da*q_saf*sin(theta) + a*cos(theta)106            e_theta = [dR_t*cos(zeta) - R*sin(zeta)*q_saf, &107                &dR_t*sin(zeta) + R*cos(zeta)*q_saf, dz_t]108        end if109        if (present(e_alpha)) then110            dR_a = da*cos(theta)111            dz_a = da*sin(theta)112            e_alpha = [dR_a*cos(zeta) - R*sin(zeta), &113                &dR_a*sin(zeta) + R*cos(zeta), dz_a]114        end if115    end subroutine torus116 117    !> Cross product.118    pure function cross(u,v) result(w)119        real(dp), intent(in) :: u(3), v(3)120        real(dp) :: w(3)121 122        w = [u(2)*v(3)-u(3)*v(2), u(3)*v(1)-u(1)*v(3), u(1)*v(2)-u(2)*v(1)]123    end function cross124 125    !> Set up the synthetic style-1 vacuum on the torus (the geometry arrays126    !! are global, so every process fills them completely; only G, H and res127    !! are distributed), and the grid module variables that calc_GH_1 reads.128    subroutine setup_torus_vac(vac,n_par,n_alpha_loc,ierr,delta)129        use grid_vars, only: min_par_X, max_par_X, min_alpha, max_alpha, n_alpha130        use rich_vars, only: n_par_X131 132        type(vac_type), intent(inout) :: vac                                    ! vacuum variables133        integer, intent(in) :: n_par, n_alpha_loc                               ! points per field line, number of field lines134        integer, intent(out) :: ierr                                            ! error status135        real(dp), intent(in), optional :: delta                                 ! ripple amplitude136 137        integer :: id, jd, kd                                                   ! counters138        real(dp) :: theta, alpha                                                ! angles139        real(dp) :: x(3), e_t(3), e_a(3)                                        ! position and tangents140 141        ! grid module variables (in units of pi, as in the input file)142        min_par_X = 0._dp143        max_par_X = 2._dp144        min_alpha = 0._dp145        max_alpha = 2._dp146        n_par_X = n_par147        n_alpha = n_alpha_loc148 149        ierr = vac%init(1,n_par*n_alpha_loc,2,[n_par,n_alpha_loc],q_saf)150        if (ierr.ne.0) return151 152        do jd = 1,n_alpha_loc153            alpha = 2._dp*pi*(jd-1)/n_alpha_loc                                 ! end point excluded, as in PB3D154            do id = 1,n_par155                theta = 2._dp*pi*(id-1)/(n_par-1)156                kd = id + (jd-1)*n_par157                call torus(theta,alpha,x,e_theta=e_t,e_alpha=e_a,delta=delta)158                vac%x_vec(kd,:) = x159                vac%norm(kd,:) = cross(e_t,e_a)                                 ! J nabla psi160                vac%h_fac(kd,1) = sum(e_a**2)                                   ! g_alpha,alpha161                vac%h_fac(kd,2) = sum(e_a*e_t)                                  ! g_alpha,theta162                vac%h_fac(kd,3) = sum(e_t**2)                                   ! g_theta,theta163            end do164        end do165    end subroutine setup_torus_vac166 167    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------168    ! tests169    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------170 171    !> The singular branch of the 3-D interval kernel against brute-force172    !! quadrature of -1/distance over the half-cell, with the metric-form173    !! distance. The inner (alpha) integral is done analytically with the174    !! elementary asinh-type primitive; the outer integral by panel-refined175    !! Gauss quadrature toward the singular corner.176    subroutine test_int_1_singular(error)177        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error178 179        real(dp), parameter :: h_fac(3) = [4.0_dp,0.9_dp,2.5_dp]                ! g_aa, g_at, g_tt180        real(dp), parameter :: steps(2) = [0.02_dp,0.03_dp]                     ! dpar, dalpha181 182        integer :: id, jd                                                       ! counters183        real(dp) :: G(2), H(2)                                                  ! kernel results184        real(dp) :: x_s(4,3), x_in(3), norm_s(4,3)                              ! geometry (only distances matter)185        real(dp) :: d(3), dn(3)                                                 ! interval vector and normal increment186        real(dp) :: s_no, sq_a, sq_t                                            ! nonorthogonality and metric roots187        real(dp) :: I_ref                                                       ! brute-force integral188        real(dp) :: p_lo, p_hi, u_q, w_q                                        ! quadrature panels and nodes189        real(dp) :: V_hc                                                        ! alpha half-cell in metric units190        real(dp) :: G_ref                                                       ! reference value191        real(dp) :: r_far                                                       ! length of the interval192 193        ! a singular interval on a straight stencil: influence point = stencil194        ! point 2 = left point of the interval; the right point sits at par195        ! distance steps(1) in the field-line direction, the normal varies196        ! linearly (the cubic interpolant reproduces both exactly)197        x_in = [1.0_dp,2.0_dp,3.0_dp]198        d = sqrt(h_fac(3))*steps(1)*[1._dp,0._dp,0._dp]199        dn = [0._dp,0._dp,0.1_dp]200        do id = 1,4201            x_s(id,:) = x_in + (id-2)*d202            norm_s(id,:) = [0.4_dp,0.5_dp,0.6_dp] + (id-2)*dn203        end do204 205        call calc_GH_int_1(G,H,x_s,x_in,norm_s,h_fac,steps,1.e-30_dp,2)206 207        ! brute force: I = int_0^{U} du int_{-V}^{V} dv / sqrt(u^2+2suv+v^2),208        ! outer u integral with geometrically refined panels toward u = 0,209        ! inner integral analytical:210        !   int dv/sqrt(...) = ln(v + su + sqrt(u^2+2suv+v^2))211        sq_a = sqrt(h_fac(1))212        sq_t = sqrt(h_fac(3))213        s_no = h_fac(2)/(sq_a*sq_t)214        V_hc = sq_a*steps(2)/2._dp215        I_ref = 0._dp216        p_hi = sq_t*steps(1)/2._dp                                              ! U: half cell in par direction217        do id = 1,60218            p_lo = p_hi*0.6_dp219            if (id.eq.60) p_lo = 0._dp220            do jd = 1,8221                u_q = 0.5_dp*(p_lo+p_hi) + 0.5_dp*(p_hi-p_lo)*gl_x(jd)222                w_q = 0.5_dp*(p_hi-p_lo)*gl_w(jd)223                if (u_q.le.0._dp) cycle224                I_ref = I_ref + w_q*log(&225                    &(V_hc+s_no*u_q+sqrt(u_q**2+2*s_no*u_q*V_hc+V_hc**2))/&226                    &(-V_hc+s_no*u_q+sqrt(u_q**2-2*s_no*u_q*V_hc+V_hc**2)))227            end do228            p_hi = p_lo229            if (p_hi.le.0._dp) exit230        end do231        G_ref = -2._dp*I_ref/(steps(1)*steps(2)*sq_a*sq_t)232 233        call check(error, G(1), G_ref, thr=1.e-8_dp*abs(G_ref), &234            &message='singular G: '//trim(r2str(G(1)))//' vs brute force '//&235            &trim(r2str(G_ref)))236        if (allocated(error)) return237 238        ! the singular endpoint carries no H contribution: calc_GH sets the239        ! diagonal of H afterwards240        call check(error, H(1), 0._dp, thr=1.e-300_dp, &241            &message='singular H not zero')242        if (allocated(error)) return243 244        ! 2 int_{1/2}^1 (n_0 + t dn).(t d) / r^3 dt248        !    = 2 (n_0.d + ln 2 dn.d) / |d|^3249        r_far = sqrt(sum(d**2))250        call check(error, G(2), -2._dp*log(2._dp)/r_far, thr=1.e-9_dp, &251            &rel=.true., message='near-end G: '//trim(r2str(G(2)))//' vs '//&252            &trim(r2str(-2._dp*log(2._dp)/r_far)))253        if (allocated(error)) return254        call check(error, H(2), 2._dp*(sum(norm_s(2,:)*d)+&255            &log(2._dp)*sum(dn*d))/r_far**3, thr=1.e-9_dp, rel=.true., &256            &message='near-end H: '//trim(r2str(H(2))))257        if (allocated(error)) return258    end subroutine test_int_1_singular259 260    !> The near-field branch of the 3-D interval kernel against brute-force261    !! quadrature over the exact curve: four stencil points on a circle with262    !! the radius of curvature of the W7-X bean tip (0.27 R_0) at the spacing263    !! of the 121-point field lines (0.06 R_0), the influence point a quarter264    !! of an interval length off the arc, where the kernel varies by a factor265    !! three across a half-interval. The reference integrates the kernels over266    !! the exact arc with panel-refined Gauss quadrature; the routine sees only267    !! the four points (cubic interpolant, 8 Gauss points per half-interval).268    subroutine test_int_1_near(error)269        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error270 271        real(dp), parameter :: R_c = 0.27_dp                                    ! radius of the arc272        real(dp), parameter :: ds = 0.06_dp                                     ! arc length between stencil points273        real(dp), parameter :: w = 0.015_dp                                     ! distance of the influence point from the arc274        real(dp), parameter :: tol = 3.e-3_dp                                   ! relative tolerance (measured 6e-4 for G, 1.2e-3 for H: the cubic interpolant of the arc is 1.3e-5 off in position, against the distance 0.015)275        integer, parameter :: n_pan = 32                                        ! panels per half-interval276 277        integer :: id, jd, kd, ip                                               ! counters278        real(dp) :: G(2), H(2)                                                  ! kernel results279        real(dp) :: x_s(4,3), x_in(3), norm_s(4,3)                              ! geometry280        real(dp) :: G_ref(2), H_ref(2)                                          ! brute-force values281        real(dp) :: t_lo, t_hi, t_q, w_q                                        ! panel limits, node and weight282        real(dp) :: x_q(3), n_q(3), r_q                                         ! position, normal and distance at a node283 284        ! stencil on the arc, interval between points 2 and 3; the normal is285        ! the (outward) radial direction, scaled to 1.5286        do id = 1,4287            call arc((id-2)*ds,x_s(id,:),norm_s(id,:))288        end do289        ! influence point: foot at 0.3 of the interval, w off the arc inward290        call arc(0.3_dp*ds,x_in,n_q)291        x_in = x_in - w*n_q/1.5_dp292 293        call calc_GH_int_1(G,H,x_s,x_in,norm_s,[1._dp,0._dp,1._dp,0._dp],&294            &[ds,ds],1.e-30_dp,2)295 296        ! brute force over the exact arc: 2 int_half K ds/ds, Gauss on panels297        do kd = 1,2298            G_ref(kd) = 0._dp299            H_ref(kd) = 0._dp300            do ip = 1,n_pan301                t_lo = 0.5_dp*(kd-1) + 0.5_dp*(ip-1)/n_pan302                t_hi = 0.5_dp*(kd-1) + 0.5_dp*ip/n_pan303                do jd = 1,8304                    t_q = 0.5_dp*(t_lo+t_hi) + 0.5_dp*(t_hi-t_lo)*gl_x(jd)305                    w_q = 0.5_dp*(t_hi-t_lo)*gl_w(jd)306                    call arc(t_q*ds,x_q,n_q)307                    r_q = sqrt(sum((x_q-x_in)**2))308                    G_ref(kd) = G_ref(kd) - 2._dp*w_q/r_q309                    H_ref(kd) = H_ref(kd) + 2._dp*w_q*sum(n_q*(x_q-x_in))/r_q**3310                end do311            end do312            call check(error, G(kd), G_ref(kd), thr=tol*abs(G_ref(kd)), &313                &message='near G('//trim(i2str(kd))//'): '//trim(r2str(G(kd)))&314                &//' vs brute force '//trim(r2str(G_ref(kd))))315            if (allocated(error)) return316            call check(error, H(kd), H_ref(kd), thr=tol*abs(H_ref(kd)), &317                &message='near H('//trim(i2str(kd))//'): '//trim(r2str(H(kd)))&318                &//' vs brute force '//trim(r2str(H_ref(kd))))319            if (allocated(error)) return320        end do321    contains322        ! point and scaled outward normal on the arc at arc length s323        subroutine arc(s,x,n)324            real(dp), intent(in) :: s325            real(dp), intent(out) :: x(3), n(3)326            n = [cos(s/R_c),sin(s/R_c),0._dp]327            x = [2._dp,0.5_dp,-1._dp] + R_c*n328            n = 1.5_dp*n329        end subroutine arc330    end subroutine test_int_1_near331 332    !> Green's identities for the assembled 3-D matrices on the torus.333    !!334    !! By the constant-potential construction of the H diagonal,338    !! c = -4 pi exactly for phi = 1; the tests establish the offsets and339    !! the discretization error for nontrivial potentials.340    subroutine test_greens_identity_3d(error)341        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error342 343        integer, parameter :: n_pars(2) = [41,81]                               ! interior harmonic: c = -4 pi; exterior harmonic: c = 0362        call check(error, res_hi(2).lt.5.e-2_dp, &363            &'interior identity residual too large: '//&364            &trim(r2str(res_hi(2))))365        if (allocated(error)) return366        call check(error, res_hi(3).lt.5.e-2_dp, &367            &'exterior identity residual too large: '//&368            &trim(r2str(res_hi(3))))369        if (allocated(error)) return370 371        ! A point source on the magnetic axis, phi = 1/|x - x_src|, is harmonic383    !! outside the surface and decays, and its normal data norm . grad phi384    !! are exact. solve_Phi_BEM (the row-sum diagonal of calc_GH is the385    !! vacuum-side corner term, so H phi = G dphi holds) must then return386    !! phi on the surface to discretization accuracy, and the error must fall387    !! with resolution. local number of columns of R and Phi444        integer :: desc_RPhi(9)                                                 ! descriptor for R and Phi445        integer, allocatable :: lims_c_R(:,:)                                   ! local column limits of R and Phi446        real(dp) :: r_src                                                       ! distance to source447        real(dp), allocatable :: phi(:), dphi(:)                                ! gathered numerical solution450 451        err = 0._dp452        call setup_torus_vac(vac,n_par,n_alpha_loc,ierr,delta=delta)453        if (ierr.ne.0) return454        n_bnd = vac%n_bnd455 456        ierr = calc_GH(vac)457        if (ierr.ne.0) return458 459        if (in_context(vac%ctxt_HG)) then460            allocate(phi(n_bnd),dphi(n_bnd))461            do id = 1,n_bnd462                r_src = sqrt(sum((vac%x_vec(id,:)-x_src)**2))463                phi(id) = 1._dp/r_src464                dphi(id) = -sum(vac%norm(id,:)*(vac%x_vec(id,:)-x_src))/&465                    &r_src**3466            end do467 468            n_col1 = n_col1_loc(vac)469            call set_loc_lims(n_col1,vac%bs,vac%ind_p(2),vac%n_p(2),lims_c_R)470            allocate(R_mat(max(1,vac%n_loc(1)),n_col1))471            allocate(Phi_mat(max(1,vac%n_loc(1)),n_col1))472            if (n_col1.gt.0) call vec_glob2dis(vac,dphi,R_mat(:,1))473            Phi_mat = 0._dp474            call descinit(desc_RPhi,n_bnd,1,vac%bs,vac%bs,0,0,vac%ctxt_HG,&475                &max(1,vac%n_loc(1)),ierr)476            if (ierr.ne.0) return477 478            ierr = solve_Phi_BEM(vac,R_mat,Phi_mat,[n_bnd,1],&479                &[vac%n_loc(1),n_col1],lims_c_R,desc_RPhi)480            if (ierr.ne.0) return481 482            allocate(phi_num(n_bnd))483            ierr = vec_dis2loc(vac%ctxt_HG,&484                &reshape(Phi_mat(1:vac%n_loc(1),:),[vac%n_loc(1)*n_col1]),&485                &vac%lims_r,phi_num)486            if (ierr.ne.0) return487 488            err = maxval(abs(phi_num-phi))/maxval(abs(phi))489            if (rank.eq.0) write(error_unit,'(A,I6,A,F5.2,A,ES10.2)') &490                &'   [point source] n = ',n_bnd,', ripple ',delta,&491                &': max |Phi - phi| / max |phi| = ',err492        end if493 494        call vac%dealloc()495    end subroutine point_source_error496 497    !> Assemble the style-1 matrices on the torus at a given resolution and498    !! x (interior harmonic)544                            phi(id) = vac%x_vec(id,1)545                            dphi(id) = vac%norm(id,1)546                        case (3)                                                ! 1/|x - x_src| (exterior harmonic, source inside)547                            r_src = sqrt(sum((vac%x_vec(id,:)-x_src)**2))548                            phi(id) = 1._dp/r_src549                            dphi(id) = -sum(vac%norm(id,:)*&550                                &(vac%x_vec(id,:)-x_src))/r_src**3551                    end select552                end do553                ierr = dis_matvec(vac,vac%H,vac%desc_H,phi,lhs)554                if (ierr.ne.0) return555                ierr = dis_matvec(vac,vac%G,vac%desc_G,dphi,rhs)556                if (ierr.ne.0) return557                lhs = lhs - rhs558                scale_phi = maxval(abs(4._dp*pi*phi))559                do id = -2,2560                    res_off(id) = maxval(abs(lhs - id*2._dp*pi*phi))/scale_phi561                end do562                if (rank.eq.0) write(error_unit,'(A,I6,A,I2,A,5ES10.2)') &563                    &'   [3d identity] n = ',n_bnd,', potential ',kind,&564                    &': residuals vs c = (-4,-2,0,2,4)pi: ',res_off565                select case (kind)566                    case (1,2)                                                  ! interior: c = -4 pi567                        res(kind) = res_off(-2)568                    case (3)                                                    ! exterior: c = 0569                        res(kind) = res_off(0)570                end select571            end do572        end if573 574        call vac%dealloc()575    end subroutine greens_residuals_3d576 577    !> Exact harmonics of the circular torus through the axisymmetric (style578    !! 2) chain.579    !!580    !! In toroidal coordinates (eta, theta_t, phi) with focal radius581    !! c = sqrt(R_0^2 - a^2) the circular torus is the surface cosh eta_0 =582    !! R_0 / a, and583    !!    sqrt(cosh eta - cos theta_t) F^n_{k-1/2}(cosh eta) cos(k theta_t) cos(n phi)584    !! is harmonic for the toroidal functions F = P (first kind: regular on585    !! the axis and at infinity, so an exterior potential) and F = Q (second586    !! kind: regular at the focal ring, so an interior one). 1!------------------------------------------------------------------------------!2!> Full-stack tests of the spline interpolation wrapper3!! (spline_utilities.spline, a PB3D-flavored interface to PSPLINE/EZspline),4!! converted from the interactive legacy check (Modules/test.f90,5!! test_splines) into automated assertions with implementation-independent6!! references:7!!8!!  - reproduction of polynomials that lie exactly in the interpolation9!!    space: linear data for order 1, and a cubic polynomial (with exact10!!    prescribed endpoint derivatives) for order 3, including all11!!    derivatives; the extrapolation outside the domain is a *quadratic*12!!    Taylor extension from the boundary (see calc_extrap in13!!    spline_utilities), so it is pinned with a quadratic polynomial;14!!  - convergence at the expected rate on sin(2 pi x) for all three orders15!!    (1: linear, 2: Akima Hermite, 3: cubic);16!!  - periodic boundary conditions on a full sin period;17!!  - refusal to extrapolate when extrap is not set (this check lives18!!    outside ldebug, so it is active in all builds).19!------------------------------------------------------------------------------!20module test_splines21    use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: error_unit22    use testdrive, only: new_unittest, unittest_type, error_type, check23    use num_vars, only: dp, pi24    use str_utilities, only: r2str, i2str25    use spline_utilities, only: spline26 27    implicit none28    private29    public collect_splines30 31contains32    !> Collect the tests.33    subroutine collect_splines(testsuite)34        type(unittest_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: testsuite(:)35 36        testsuite = [ &37            &new_unittest("linear_exact_on_linear", test_linear_exact), &38            &new_unittest("cubic_exact_on_cubic", test_cubic_exact), &39            &new_unittest("cubic_extrapolation", test_cubic_extrap), &40            &new_unittest("sin_convergence", test_sin_convergence), &41            &new_unittest("periodic_bc_sin", test_periodic_sin), &42            &new_unittest("extrapolation_refused", test_extrap_refused) &43            &]44    end subroutine collect_splines45 46    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------47    ! helpers48    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------49 50    !> The cubic test polynomial and its derivatives.51    pure function cubic_poly(x,deriv) result(res)52        real(dp), intent(in) :: x53        integer, intent(in) :: deriv54        real(dp) :: res55 56        select case (deriv)57            case (0)58                res = x**3 - 2._dp*x**2 + 3._dp*x - 1._dp59            case (1)60                res = 3._dp*x**2 - 4._dp*x + 3._dp61            case (2)62                res = 6._dp*x - 4._dp63            case (3)64                res = 6._dp65            case default66                res = 0._dp67        end select68    end function cubic_poly69 70    !> Maximum error of the spline of order ord and derivative deriv against71    !! sin(2 pi x) sampled on nx points, evaluated on a fine interior grid,72    !! normalized by the amplitude (2 pi)^deriv of the derivative.73    integer function sin_err(nx,ord,deriv,err) result(ierr)74        integer, intent(in) :: nx, ord, deriv                                   ! knots, order, derivative75        real(dp), intent(out) :: err                                            ! normalized maximum error76 77        integer, parameter :: nx_int = 301                                      ! evaluation points78        integer :: kd                                                           ! counter79        real(dp) :: x(nx), y(nx)                                                ! knots80        real(dp) :: x_int(nx_int), y_int(nx_int), y_ref(nx_int)                 ! evaluation81 82        do kd = 1,nx83            x(kd) = (kd-1._dp)/(nx-1._dp)84            y(kd) = sin(2._dp*pi*x(kd))85        end do86        do kd = 1,nx_int87            x_int(kd) = (kd-1._dp)/(nx_int-1._dp)88            select case (deriv)89                case (0)90                    y_ref(kd) = sin(2._dp*pi*x_int(kd))91                case (1)92                    y_ref(kd) = 2._dp*pi*cos(2._dp*pi*x_int(kd))93            end select94        end do95 96        ierr = spline(x,y,x_int,y_int,ord=ord,deriv=deriv)97        if (ierr.ne.0) return98 99        err = maxval(abs(y_int-y_ref))/(2._dp*pi)**deriv100    end function sin_err101 102    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------103    ! tests104    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------105 106    !> Order 1 reproduces linear data exactly, including the derivative.107    subroutine test_linear_exact(error)108        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error109 110        integer, parameter :: nx = 7, nx_int = 50                               ! knots, evaluation points111        integer :: ierr, kd                                                     ! error status, counter112        real(dp) :: x(nx), y(nx)                                                ! knots113        real(dp) :: x_int(nx_int), y_int(nx_int)                                ! evaluation114 115        do kd = 1,nx116            x(kd) = 2._dp*(kd-1._dp)/(nx-1._dp)                                 ! knots, evaluation points145        integer :: ierr, kd, deriv                                              ! error status, counters146        real(dp) :: x(nx), y(nx)                                                ! knots147        real(dp) :: x_int(nx_int), y_int(nx_int), y_ref(nx_int)                 ! evaluation148        real(dp) :: err                                                         ! maximum error149 150        do kd = 1,nx151            x(kd) = 2._dp*(kd-1._dp)/(nx-1._dp)                                 ! 0..2152            y(kd) = cubic_poly(x(kd),0)153        end do154        do kd = 1,nx_int155            x_int(kd) = 2._dp*(kd-1._dp)/(nx_int-1._dp)156        end do157 158        do deriv = 0,3159            ierr = spline(x,y,x_int,y_int,ord=3,deriv=deriv,bcs=[1,1],&160                &bcs_val=[cubic_poly(x(1),1),cubic_poly(x(nx),1)])161            call check(error, ierr, 0, 'spline failed for derivative '//&162                &trim(i2str(deriv)))163            if (allocated(error)) return164            do kd = 1,nx_int165                y_ref(kd) = cubic_poly(x_int(kd),deriv)166            end do167            err = maxval(abs(y_int-y_ref))/maxval(abs(y_ref))168            call check(error, err.lt.1.e-9_dp, &169                &'cubic spline not exact on cubic polynomial, derivative '//&170                &trim(i2str(deriv))//': '//trim(r2str(err)))171            if (allocated(error)) return172        end do173    end subroutine test_cubic_exact174 175    !> The extrapolation is the quadratic Taylor extension from the boundary176    !! (calc_extrap in spline_utilities), so it stays exact for a quadratic177    !! polynomial with exact prescribed endpoint first derivatives.178    subroutine test_cubic_extrap(error)179        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error180 181        integer, parameter :: nx = 12, nx_int = 60                              ! knots, evaluation points182        integer :: ierr, kd                                                     ! error status, counter183        real(dp) :: x(nx), y(nx)                                                ! knots184        real(dp) :: x_int(nx_int), y_int(nx_int), y_ref(nx_int)                 ! evaluation185        real(dp) :: err                                                         ! maximum error186 187        do kd = 1,nx188            x(kd) = 2._dp*(kd-1._dp)/(nx-1._dp)                                 ! 0..2189            y(kd) = x(kd)**2 - 3._dp*x(kd) + 2._dp190        end do191        do kd = 1,nx_int192            x_int(kd) = -0.5_dp + 3._dp*(kd-1._dp)/(nx_int-1._dp)               ! -0.5..2.5: 0.5 extrapolated on both sides193            y_ref(kd) = x_int(kd)**2 - 3._dp*x_int(kd) + 2._dp194        end do195 196        ierr = spline(x,y,x_int,y_int,ord=3,deriv=0,bcs=[1,1],&197            &bcs_val=[2._dp*x(1)-3._dp,2._dp*x(nx)-3._dp],extrap=.true.)198        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'spline failed')199        if (allocated(error)) return200 201        err = maxval(abs(y_int-y_ref))/maxval(abs(y_ref))202        call check(error, err.lt.1.e-9_dp, &203            &'quadratic extrapolation not exact on quadratic polynomial: '//&204            &trim(r2str(err)))205        if (allocated(error)) return206    end subroutine test_cubic_extrap207 208    !> Convergence on sin(2 pi x) when doubling the number of knots, for all209    !! three orders: the error has to drop at least by the conservative210    !! factors below (theoretical rates: 4 for linear, 8 for Akima, 16 for211    !! cubic), and be small in absolute terms at the finer resolution.212    subroutine test_sin_convergence(error)213        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error214 215        real(dp), parameter :: ratio_min(3) = [3._dp,5._dp,10._dp]              ! minimum error-reduction factors216        real(dp), parameter :: err_max(3) = [4.e-3_dp,4.e-4_dp,3.e-5_dp]        ! maximum normalized errors at nx = 41 (ord 1 theory: h^2 |f''| / 8 = 3.1e-3)217 218        integer :: ierr, ord, deriv                                             ! error status, counters219        real(dp) :: err_lo, err_hi                                              ! errors at nx = 21 and 41220 221        do ord = 1,3222            do deriv = 0,1223                ierr = sin_err(21,ord,deriv,err_lo)224                call check(error, ierr, 0, 'spline failed')225                if (allocated(error)) return226                ierr = sin_err(41,ord,deriv,err_hi)227                call check(error, ierr, 0, 'spline failed')228                if (allocated(error)) return229                write(error_unit,'(A,I2,A,I2,A,ES10.3,A,ES10.3)') &230                    &'   [spline convergence] ord ',ord,', deriv ',deriv,&231                    &': err 21 = ',err_lo,', err 41 = ',err_hi232                if (deriv.eq.0) then233                    call check(error, err_hi.lt.err_max(ord), &234                        &'error too large for order '//trim(i2str(ord))//&235                        &': '//trim(r2str(err_hi)))236                    if (allocated(error)) return237                    call check(error, err_hi.lt.err_lo/ratio_min(ord), &238                        &'no convergence for order '//trim(i2str(ord))//&239                        &': '//trim(r2str(err_lo))//' -> '//trim(r2str(err_hi)))240                    if (allocated(error)) return241                else242                    call check(error, err_hi.lt.err_lo, &                       ! derivative errors converge more slowly; just require decrease243                        &'derivative error grows for order '//&244                        &trim(i2str(ord))//': '//trim(r2str(err_lo))//' -> '//&245                        &trim(r2str(err_hi)))246                    if (allocated(error)) return247                end if248            end do249        end do250    end subroutine test_sin_convergence251 252    !> Periodic boundary conditions on a full sin period: the periodic cubic253    !! spline has to be accurate up to the second derivative and exactly254    !! periodic at the seam.255    subroutine test_periodic_sin(error)256        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error257 258        integer, parameter :: nx = 21, nx_int = 301                             ! knots, evaluation points259        real(dp), parameter :: tol(0:2) = [1.e-4_dp,1.e-3_dp,1.e-2_dp]          ! normalized tolerances per derivative260 261        integer :: ierr, kd, deriv                                              ! error status, counters262        real(dp) :: x(nx), y(nx)                                                ! knots263        real(dp) :: x_int(nx_int), y_int(nx_int), y_ref(nx_int)                 ! evaluation264        real(dp) :: err                                                         ! maximum error265        real(dp) :: y_seam(2)                                                   ! values at both ends266 267        do kd = 1,nx268            x(kd) = (kd-1._dp)/(nx-1._dp)269            y(kd) = sin(2._dp*pi*x(kd))270        end do271        do kd = 1,nx_int272            x_int(kd) = (kd-1._dp)/(nx_int-1._dp)273        end do274 275        do deriv = 0,2276            ierr = spline(x,y,x_int,y_int,ord=3,deriv=deriv,bcs=[-1,-1])277            call check(error, ierr, 0, 'spline failed for derivative '//&278                &trim(i2str(deriv)))279            if (allocated(error)) return280            do kd = 1,nx_int281                y_ref(kd) = (2._dp*pi)**deriv*&282                    &sin(2._dp*pi*x_int(kd)+deriv*pi/2._dp)283            end do284            err = maxval(abs(y_int-y_ref))/(2._dp*pi)**deriv285            write(error_unit,'(A,I2,A,ES10.3)') &286                &'   [periodic spline] deriv ',deriv,': err = ',err287            call check(error, err.lt.tol(deriv), &288                &'periodic spline error too large for derivative '//&289                &trim(i2str(deriv))//': '//trim(r2str(err)))290            if (allocated(error)) return291 292            ! seam periodicity293            y_seam(1) = y_int(1)294            y_seam(2) = y_int(nx_int)295            call check(error, abs(y_seam(2)-y_seam(1)).lt.1.e-10_dp*&296                &(2._dp*pi)**deriv, &297                &'periodic spline not periodic at the seam for derivative '//&298                &trim(i2str(deriv)))299            if (allocated(error)) return300        end do301    end subroutine test_periodic_sin302 303    !> Evaluation outside the domain without extrap has to fail (this check304    !! is active in all builds, not only ldebug).305    subroutine test_extrap_refused(error)306        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error307 308        integer, parameter :: nx = 7                                            ! knots309        integer :: ierr, kd                                                     ! error status, counter310        real(dp) :: x(nx), y(nx)                                                ! knots311        real(dp) :: x_int(3), y_int(3)                                          ! evaluation with an exterior point312 313        do kd = 1,nx314            x(kd) = (kd-1._dp)/(nx-1._dp)315            y(kd) = x(kd)**2316        end do317        x_int = [0.2_dp,0.8_dp,1.5_dp]                                          ! last point outside318 319        ierr = spline(x,y,x_int,y_int,ord=3,deriv=0)320        call check(error, ierr.ne.0, &321            &'extrapolation without extrap=.true. was not refused')322        if (allocated(error)) return323    end subroutine test_extrap_refused324end module test_splines

1!------------------------------------------------------------------------------!2!> Full-stack tests of the volume integral (grid_utilities.calc_int_vol),3!! converted from the interactive legacy check (Modules/test.f90,4!! test_calc_int_vol) into automated assertions.5!!6!! The reference is the analytical integral of7!!    f = 1 - r^2 + i cos(theta)8!! over a torus with geometric axis R_0 and minor radius 1, with the flux9!! Jacobian J = r (R_0 + r cos(theta)):10!!    int f J dtheta dzeta dr = R_0 pi^2 + i 2 pi^2 / 3 .11!! The grid follows PB3D's convention (theta varies in dimension 1, zeta in12!! dimension 2, the normal variable in dimension 3, angles 0..2 pi inclusive,13!! r in 0..1).14!!15!! Covered: absolute agreement at a moderate resolution, second-order16!! convergence (the cell-averaged rule is trapezoidal for independent17!! coordinates), and the behavior for a single point in dimension 2: the18!! implementation substitutes the full turn 2 pi for the missing angular19!! extent (transf_J is set to 2 pi for a singleton dimension), so an20!! axisymmetric integrand yields the complete toroidal integral.21!------------------------------------------------------------------------------!22module test_calc_int_vol23    use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: error_unit24    use testdrive, only: new_unittest, unittest_type, error_type, check25    use num_vars, only: dp, pi, iu26    use str_utilities, only: r2str, i2str27    use grid_utilities, only: calc_eqd_grid, calc_int_vol28 29    implicit none30    private31    public collect_calc_int_vol32 33    real(dp), parameter :: R_0 = 2._dp                                          ! geometric axis of torus34 35contains36    !> Collect the tests.37    subroutine collect_calc_int_vol(testsuite)38        type(unittest_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: testsuite(:)39 40        testsuite = [ &41            &new_unittest("torus_analytic", test_torus_analytic), &42            &new_unittest("torus_convergence", test_torus_convergence), &43            &new_unittest("decoupled_dim_2", test_decoupled_dim_2) &44            &]45    end subroutine collect_calc_int_vol46 47    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------48    ! helpers49    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------50 51    !> Numerical integral of f = 1 - r^2 + i cos(theta) with J = r (R_0 +52    !! r cos(theta)) on a (theta, zeta, r) grid of the given dimensions.53    integer function torus_int(dims,f_int) result(ierr)54        integer, intent(in) :: dims(3)                                          ! grid size55        complex(dp), intent(out) :: f_int(1)                                    ! integral56 57        integer :: id, kd                                                       ! counters58        real(dp) :: r                                                           ! minor radius59        real(dp), allocatable :: theta(:,:,:), zeta(:,:,:)                      ! angles60        real(dp), allocatable :: norm(:)                                        ! normal variable61        real(dp), allocatable :: J(:,:,:)                                       ! Jacobian62        complex(dp), allocatable :: fun(:,:,:,:)                                ! integrand63 64        allocate(theta(dims(1),dims(2),dims(3)))65        allocate(zeta(dims(1),dims(2),dims(3)))66        allocate(J(dims(1),dims(2),dims(3)))67        allocate(fun(dims(1),dims(2),dims(3),1))68        allocate(norm(dims(3)))69 70        ierr = calc_eqd_grid(theta,0._dp,2._dp*pi,1)71        if (ierr.ne.0) return72        if (dims(2).gt.1) then73            ierr = calc_eqd_grid(zeta,0._dp,2._dp*pi,2)74            if (ierr.ne.0) return75        else76            zeta = 0._dp77        end if78        ierr = calc_eqd_grid(norm,0._dp,1._dp)79        if (ierr.ne.0) return80 81        do kd = 1,dims(3)82            r = norm(kd)83            fun(:,:,kd,1) = 1._dp - r**2 + iu*cos(theta(:,:,kd))84            do id = 1,dims(1)85                J(id,:,kd) = r*(R_0+r*cos(theta(id,:,kd)))86            end do87        end do88 89        f_int = 0._dp90        ierr = calc_int_vol(theta,zeta,norm,J,fun,f_int)91    end function torus_int92 93    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------94    ! tests95    !--------------------------------------------------------------------------96 97    !> Agreement with the analytical value at a moderate resolution.98    subroutine test_torus_analytic(error)99        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error100 101        real(dp), parameter :: tol = 5.e-3_dp                                   ! relative tolerance102 103        integer :: ierr                                                         ! error status104        complex(dp) :: f_int(1)                                                 ! numerical integral105        complex(dp) :: f_ana                                                    ! analytical integral106        real(dp) :: err                                                         ! relative error107 108        ierr = torus_int([33,34,21],f_int)109        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'calc_int_vol failed')110        if (allocated(error)) return111 112        f_ana = R_0*pi**2 + iu*2._dp*pi**2/3._dp113        err = abs(f_int(1)-f_ana)/abs(f_ana)114        write(error_unit,'(A,2ES12.4,A,2ES12.4,A,ES10.3)') &115            &'   [int_vol] numerical = ',f_int(1),', analytical = ',f_ana,&116            &', rel err = ',err117        call check(error, err.lt.tol, &118            &'torus integral deviates from analytical: '//trim(r2str(err)))119        if (allocated(error)) return120    end subroutine test_torus_analytic121 122    !> Doubling the resolution has to reduce the error by ~4 (second order);123    !! require at least a factor 3.124    subroutine test_torus_convergence(error)125        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error126 127        integer :: ierr                                                         ! error status128        complex(dp) :: f_int(1)                                                 ! numerical integral129        complex(dp) :: f_ana                                                    ! analytical integral130        real(dp) :: err_lo, err_hi                                              ! errors at the two resolutions131 132        f_ana = R_0*pi**2 + iu*2._dp*pi**2/3._dp133 134        ierr = torus_int([17,18,11],f_int)135        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'calc_int_vol failed')136        if (allocated(error)) return137        err_lo = abs(f_int(1)-f_ana)/abs(f_ana)138 139        ierr = torus_int([33,34,21],f_int)140        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'calc_int_vol failed')141        if (allocated(error)) return142        err_hi = abs(f_int(1)-f_ana)/abs(f_ana)143 144        write(error_unit,'(A,ES10.3,A,ES10.3)') &145            &'   [int_vol convergence] err coarse = ',err_lo,&146            &', err fine = ',err_hi147        call check(error, err_hi.lt.err_lo/3._dp, &148            &'no second-order convergence: '//trim(r2str(err_lo))//' -> '//&149            &trim(r2str(err_hi)))150        if (allocated(error)) return151    end subroutine test_torus_convergence152 153    !> A single point in dimension 2: the implementation substitutes the154    !! full turn 2 pi for the missing angular extent, so the axisymmetric155    !! integrand (zeta does not appear in f or J) has to give the complete156    !! toroidal integral again.157    subroutine test_decoupled_dim_2(error)158        type(error_type), allocatable, intent(out) :: error159 160        real(dp), parameter :: tol = 5.e-3_dp                                   ! relative tolerance161 162        integer :: ierr                                                         ! error status163        complex(dp) :: f_int(1)                                                 ! numerical integral164        complex(dp) :: f_ana                                                    ! analytical integral165        real(dp) :: err                                                         ! relative error166 167        ierr = torus_int([65,1,41],f_int)168        call check(error, ierr, 0, 'calc_int_vol failed')169        if (allocated(error)) return170 171        f_ana = R_0*pi**2 + iu*2._dp*pi**2/3._dp172        err = abs(f_int(1)-f_ana)/abs(f_ana)173        write(error_unit,'(A,2ES12.4,A,2ES12.4,A,ES10.3)') &174            &'   [int_vol dim-2 = 1] numerical = ',f_int(1),&175            &', analytical = ',f_ana,', rel err = ',err176        call check(error, err.lt.tol, &177            &'singleton-dimension integral deviates from analytical: '//&178            &trim(r2str(err)))179        if (allocated(error)) return180    end subroutine test_decoupled_dim_2181end module test_calc_int_vol
